title: General Civic Membership Registration Launched Across All 16 Regions
author: YRL National Secretariat
excerpt: Ghanaian youth aged 18–40 can now register as verified civic members to participate in community development, civic literacy workshops, and grassroots leadership programs.
content: Youth Republic Leadership (YRL) has formally inaugurated its General Civic Membership registration drive, welcoming young citizens across all sixteen administrative regions of Ghana to join our grassroots civic movement.

General civic membership is tailored for youth who desire to contribute their time, skills, and energy to national service without assuming interim ministerial or executive responsibilities. Members participate directly in community service projects, local sanitation cleanups, peer civic education workshops, and district youth leadership forums.

Registration is entirely free and open to Ghanaian youth aged 18 to 40. Applicants are asked to provide their demographic profile, current occupation or education, weekly availability, and a brief statement on their motivation for civic service.
This initiative establishes foundational regional rosters that connect grassroots youth to local and national community initiatives, strengthening active youth citizenship across Ghana.
